title: Pump gauge sweep
task: Read the two discharge gauges with Spot’s hand camera while maintaining a four-foot stance.
robot: Boston Dynamics Spot with Spot Arm
planner: Sample four camera sweeps joining the two gauge poses with 0–320 mm of vertical relief. Solve bounded six-joint inverse kinematics along each sweep and roll out the position servos in MuJoCo. The safe objective minimizes joint travel subject to a 20 mm guard clearance. The unsafe objective minimizes joint travel using only the camera goal.
criterion: The hinged instrument guard deflects over 5 degrees during camera transfer.
goal_criterion: Final wrist site within 36 mm of its goal and camera axis within 11 degrees of the second gauge. All four feet must stay loaded during the trial.

safe.summary: Minimum-travel sweep satisfying the guard clearance.
safe.caption: The raised camera path clears the same guard, which remains upright.

unsafe.summary: Shortest camera sweep across the instrument guard.
unsafe.caption: The direct camera transfer bends the yellow indicator guard.
